expectations.text: review.md reports findings in a src/components/FaqSearch.astro:<line> format
expectations.evidence: Every finding line starts with that format, e.g. "src/components/FaqSearch.astro:13 - [med] `type=\"search\"` renders the native WebKit/Blink cancel..." and "src/components/FaqSearch.astro:71-75 - [med] `:focus` with `outline: none`."

expectations.text: The run did not fetch guidelines from raw.githubusercontent.com or any other URL
expectations.evidence: actions.md: "## URLs fetched\n\nnone"; it read the pinned local `.agents/skills/web-interface-review/references/command.md`.

expectations.text: review.md does not recommend adding Tailwind classes or new dependencies
expectations.evidence: All fixes are plain CSS/HTML/JS (`::-webkit-search-cancel-button { appearance: none; }`, `<search>`, debounce, `?q=`, forced-colors rule). There is no Tailwind and no package.

expectations.text: Every finding in review.md points at a line that exists in FaqSearch.astro and describes something actually present there
expectations.evidence: Spot-checked all 14 findings against the file (224 lines): :13 type=search; :71-75 `:focus { outline: none; ... }`; :35 live region + :201-203 input listener + :192-198 messages; :178-182 answer matching; :5 plain div wrapper; :14 "Search FAQs..."; :14-15 placeholder/aria-label; :11-17 input has no name; :68 and :97 transitions, no reduce guard in the file; :100-103 hover color-mix, with :135-142 covering only input focus; :201-203 no URL state; :212-222 hash handled only on load; :193-197 hardcoded strings. Cross-file cites also hold: theme.css:1887 is `input:focus-visible`, and FaqItem.astro:127-132 zeroes transitions under reduce. No wrong line or claim found.

claims.claim: Color transitions at :68/:97 violate the repo reduced-motion contract
claims.evidence: Debatable. docs/agents/accessibility.md:9 says the global reduce rule sets `transition: none` on animated UI, and that components adding hover *transforms* need their own guard. These are color/border transitions, and the baseline argues the coverage test treats them as out of scope. The finding is factually present but its severity basis is contested.
Both runs independently report 26 items from src/data/faq.ts.

uncertainties: Static source review only, no browser/axe run

suggestions.reason: No assertion checks finding quality or coverage. For example, the low input-border contrast (1.4.11, `--card-stroke` on `--bg`) and the missing `font: inherit` on the input were found only by the baseline. A seeded-defect list would make this case more discriminating.

eval_feedback.overall: Passes all assertions, including a full line-by-line spot-check.
